definitions.explanation: Mimetic word describing the involuntary shaking of the body due to cold, fear, or anger. Represents a rapid, fine vibration of the whole body or parts of it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}くて→寒い：00664_samui⟧ぶるぶる⟦{震|ふる}えた→震える：02411_furueru⟧。
examples.english: I was shivering from the cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{怖|こわ}がってぶるぶる⟦{震|ふる}えている→震える：02411_furueru⟧。
examples.english: The dog is trembling with fear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぶるぶる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{震|ふる}えた→震える：02411_furueru⟧。
⟦{薄着|うすぎ}→薄着：14028_usugi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}たら→出る：00513_deru⟧、ぶるぶる⟦{震|ふる}え→震え：18840_furue⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらなかった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: When I went outside in light clothing, I couldn't stop shivering.

notes:
One of the most common body-related onomatopoeia in Japanese. The voiced consonant ぶ gives it a heavier, more visceral feeling than the lighter ⟦がたがた→がたがた：05274_gatagata⟧. Always involuntary — the shaking is caused by an external stimulus (cold, fear, anger) that the person cannot control.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ぶるぶる⟦{震|ふる}える→震える：02411_furueru⟧: to tremble/shiver
- ぶるぶる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{震|ふる}える→震える：02411_furueru⟧: to tremble (with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ particle)
- ⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぶるぶる: shivering from cold
- ⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぶるぶる: trembling with fear

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦がたがた→がたがた：05274_gatagata⟧⟦{震|ふる}える→震える：02411_furueru⟧: to shiver violently — stronger, implies teeth chattering or louder shaking
- わなわな⟦{震|ふる}える→震える：02411_furueru⟧: to tremble (with emotion) — emphasizes emotional intensity, especially anger or shock
- ⟦ぷるぷる→ぷるぷる：28624_purupuru⟧: to quiver — lighter, cuter vibration; used for jelly-like textures or small movements
